                SELECT base.id, (
            SELECT (sort_c.data->>'rating')::numeric
            FROM components_benchproduct sort_c
            WHERE sort_c.entity_id = base.id
            AND sort_c.type_id = $2::text
            AND sort_c.deleted_at IS NULL
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS _sv FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ec.entity_id as id FROM components_benchproduct ec WHERE ec.type_id = $1::text AND ec.deleted_at IS NULL) AS base
            )
            SELECT _sorted.id FROM _sorted
            WHERE (_sorted._sv < $3::numeric OR (_sorted._sv = $4::numeric AND _sorted.id > $5::uuid))
            ORDER BY _sorted._sv DESC NULLS LAST, _sorted.id ASC LIMIT $6
